title: Fix loop R3: visual fidelity to mockups — brand color, save bar, stat strip, table icons, toggle switch

title: Fix loop R2: pagination 0-indexed off-by-one
description:
V2 list page returns no data. v1 sends currentPage=0 for first page (0-indexed); v2 sends currentPage=1 (1-indexed → page 2 → empty).

Files to fix:
- _v2/_hooks/useRolesQuery.ts: convert filter.page (1-indexed UI) to currentPage (0-indexed API): currentPage: Math.max(0, page - 1). Convert API response back to 1-indexed: page: pageMeta.currentPage + 1.
- _v2/_components/RoleDetailPanel/UsersTab.tsx: also uses currentPage=pagination.pageIndex — verify if that's already 0-indexed (likely yes from react-table) and confirm.

Acceptance:
- Network request shows currentPage=0 when on UI page 1
- Roles render in v2 list view
- Pagination next/prev work correctly
- Build/tsc/lint/tests still green
- Add a unit test in useRolesQuery test for this conversion (or annotate via permissionDiff-style util)
close_reason: Fixed off-by-one pagination at API boundary in useRolesQuery. UI is 1-indexed (filter.page = 1, 2, 3); API is 0-indexed (currentPage = 0, 1, 2). Convert via uiPageToApi/apiPageToUi helpers in paginationConvert.ts. Unit test added (8 tests pass). UsersTab.tsx reviewed: no change needed (pageIndex defaults to 0 and is already 0-indexed). Build/tsc/lint/tests all pass. Branch agent/agentflow-5bg-pagination-fix pushed.

title: RateCheckModal only auto-opens with ?is-dev=true (data feed gated behind dev-only ReportRefinance)
description: On the public report page /[id], the RateCheckModal (always rendered) gets its bestRateData/currentMortgage from page state comparisonData, which is populated ONLY by the dev-only <ReportRefinance onComparisonDataReady> inside the {isDev && ...} block. title: lf-iq v2 Roles: GET /v1/roles/{id} 500 — remove broken getRoleById fallback in useSelectedRoleDetail
description: The v2 Roles page hook useSelectedRoleDetail falls back to getRoleById() -> GET /v1/roles/{id} when the selected role (?role= in URL) is not yet in currentPageRoles (e.g. before the list query resolves). The lfiq-backend RoleController has NO GET /v1/roles/{id} route (only GET /v1/roles list, GET /v1/roles/{id}/permissions, PATCH/DELETE /{id}, POST assign/unassign-users), so it returns 500 'Request method GET is not supported'. Fix: remove the fallback fetch and resolve the role purely from the already-fetched list (pageSize=200 fetches all roles). Also remove now-unused getRoleById from private-api.ts. Reported by Tai Pham.
close_reason: Fixed: removed getRoleById fallback (GET /v1/roles/{id} 500); resolve role from list. PR #699→master, #700→production, both merged. Live on production (56b1367b).

description:

REFERENCE:
  - src/main/java/com/loanfactory/lfiq/releasenote/service/ (structural template)
  - SecurityUtils.getCurrentUserId(true) — returns real user id (login-as safe)
  - EntityService — injected via constructor (mirror releasenote pattern)

SavedFilterService interface methods:
  SavedFilterEntity create(CreateSavedFilterRequest request)
  SavedFilterEntity update(String id, UpdateSavedFilterRequest request)
  void delete(String id)
  SavedFilterEntity getOwnedById(String id)
  Page<SavedFilterEntity> listByCurrentUser(String target, Pageable pageable, Specification<SavedFilterEntity> searchSpec)

SavedFilterServiceImpl:
  Constructor-inject EntityService.

  create(request):
    1. userId = SecurityUtils.getCurrentUserId(true)
    2. Build entity: SavedFilterEntity.builder().userId(userId).target(request.getTarget())...build()
    3. entityService.save(entity) and return

  update(id, request):
    1. entity = getOwnedById(id)
    2. Apply non-null scalar fields (name, filter, sort, search, url, metadata)
    3. isDefault handling deferred to task 1.4
    4. entityService.save(entity) and return

  delete(id):
    entity = getOwnedById(id); entityService.delete(entity)

  getOwnedById(id):
    Build Specification: id eq id AND user_id eq currentUserId
    entityService.getOneBy(...) — throw ResourceNotFoundException("Saved filter [%s] not found") when null (do NOT leak existence to other users)

  listByCurrentUser(target, pageable, searchSpec):
    Compose spec: (user_id eq currentUserId) AND (target eq target if non-null) AND (searchSpec if non-null)
    entityService.getAllBy(SavedFilterEntity.class, spec, pageable)
    Default ordering is_default desc, name asc when pageable has no sort

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- ./gradlew compileJava passes
- create stamps userId from SecurityUtils
- update/delete throw ResourceNotFoundException when preset belongs to a different user

title: lo-homepage + lf-homepage: tryRedirect old->new URL renames should be 301 not 307 (SEO)

title: FIX R8: Align modal + fetch patterns with lf-homepage conventions
description:
REPO: lf-homepage
BASE BRANCH: agent/8c88-fix-r7-responsive-layout
FEATURE BRANCH: agent/8c88-fix-r8-modal-fetch-conventions

User feedback: code style in admin-safeexamcenter doesn't follow project conventions. 2 specific items:

## Item 1 — Use project's useModal hook
Project has custom hook at `@hooks/modal/useModal` (src/hooks/modal/useModal.tsx) that wraps NiceModal + Recoil + delay logic.

Reference: src/app/[locale]/(public)/demo/modal/page.tsx + TestModal.tsx

### Current (wrong)
- `AttemptCell.tsx`: `NiceModal.show(ExamResultDetailModal, { examId })`
- `ExamResultDetailModal.tsx`: wrapped with `NiceModal.create(...)` itself

### Target (correct)
- `AttemptCell.tsx`:
  ```ts
  import useModal from '@hooks/modal/useModal'
  ...
  const modal = useModal(ExamResultDetailModal)
  ...
  onClick={() => modal.show({ examId: result.exam_id })}
  ```
- `ExamResultDetailModal.tsx`:
  - REMOVE the `NiceModal.create(...)` wrapper — the project's `useModal` wraps it internally
  - Accept `modalState: IMantineModalState` prop (along with `examId: string`)
  - Render `<Modal {...modalState} title={t('modal.title')} ...>...</Modal>`
  - Close via `modalState.onClose()` (NOT `modal.hide()` from `useBaseModal`)

## Item 2 — Use async/await + try/catch/finally with named function inside useEffect
Reference: src/app/[locale]/(private)/manage-event/_components/ManageEventClient/index.tsx (uses named `fetchData` with try/catch/finally pattern)

### Current (wrong) — in ManageSafeExamCenterClient.tsx
```ts
useEffect(() => {
  setStatsLoading(true)
  mosoAidApi.getAdminExamStats()
    .then((s) => setStats(s))
    .catch(() => setStats(undefined))
    .finally(() => setStatsLoading(false))
}, [refreshNonce])
```

### Target (correct)
```ts
const fetchStats = async () => {
  try {
    setStatsLoading(true)
    const s = await mosoAidApi.getAdminExamStats()
    setStats(s)
  } catch {
    setStats(undefined)
  } finally {
    setStatsLoading(false)
  }
}

useEffect(() => {
  fetchStats()
}, [refreshNonce])
```

Also check ExamResultDetailModal data fetching — if it uses .then chain or inline promises, refactor to named async function with try/catch/finally.

## Files to change
1. src/app/[locale]/(private)/manage-safeexamcenter/_components/AttemptCell.tsx
2. src/app/[locale]/(private)/manage-safeexamcenter/_components/ExamResultDetailModal.tsx
3. src/app/[locale]/(private)/manage-safeexamcenter/_components/ManageSafeExamCenterClient.tsx

## Out of scope
- DO NOT touch mosoAidApi.ts (keep its existing request<T>() wrapper)
- DO NOT touch useSafeExamUsers.ts (already follows pattern)
- DO NOT touch other components

## Acceptance
- AttemptCell click opens modal correctly using `useModal(ExamResultDetailModal).show({ examId })`
- ExamResultDetailModal opens, loads detail, displays correctly, closes on backdrop click / Esc / close button
- Stats strip loads on mount + refresh
- No .then/.catch/.finally chains in component code (use async/await + try/catch/finally)
- lint/tsc/build clean
close_reason: Done — useModal hook adopted in ExamResultDetailModal (NiceModal.create wrap removed, modalState prop added, Modal spread with {...modalState}); AttemptCell updated to useModal(ExamResultDetailModal).show() pattern; ManageSafeExamCenterClient stats fetch refactored to named async try/catch/finally. Branch: agent/7yl6-modal-fetch-conventions (repo: lf-homepage). tsc clean, lint clean, build passes. Manual test: navigate /manage-safeexamcenter?x-moso-user-id=test, click attempt badge — modal opens, detail loads, closes via X/Esc/backdrop. Stats strip shows numbers on mount and after Refresh.

title: FIX R1: API parser + remove token gate (mosoAidApi + useSafeExamUsers)
description:
## FIX R1 — Two runtime bugs found by TESTER (Round 1)

Both fixes land in a SINGLE branch + SINGLE commit. Manual smoke requires both working together.

**Repo:** lf-homepage
**Base branch (where ALL FE work is merged):** agent/8c88.2.9-fe-final-gate
**Fix branch name:** agent/<this-bead-id>-fix-admin-exam-users-runtime
**After fix:** open PRs per lf-homepage workflow:
  - feature → master (auto-merge)
  - feature → release (auto-merge)
  - release → production (CREATE but DO NOT MERGE — user merges manually)

---

## FIX 1 — API response parser in mosoAidApi.getAdminExamUsers

**File:** src/apis/mosoAidApi.ts (lines ~241-253 in current state)

**Problem:**
The function currently reads the response as:
  { data: AdminExamUser[], pagination: { page, total, totalPages } }

But the backend ApiResponse<T> envelope actually returns:
  { success: true, data: { items: AdminExamUser[], page, limit, total, totalPages } }

At runtime body.data is an object (not array) and body.pagination is undefined.
The admin table renders empty / crashes.

**Required changes to getAdminExamUsers:**
1. Read items from body.data.items (array)
2. Read total from body.data.total
3. Read page from body.data.page
4. Read totalPages from body.data.totalPages
5. Read limit from body.data.limit and expose as pageSize on the returned object (per feedback_pagesize_naming — downstream consumers use pageSize not limit)
6. If body.success === false, throw an error using the EXISTING error-handling pattern in the file (look at neighboring helpers — do NOT invent a new error shape)
7. Null-safety: if body.data is missing or body.data.items is not an array, return { items: [], total: 0, page: 1, totalPages: 1, pageSize } rather than throwing (per feedback_null_checks)

**Do NOT touch:**
- The wire-level request (the pageSize → limit mapping on the URL query string stays as-is)
- Any other helpers in this file

**Acceptance criteria FIX 1:**
- Function reads body.data.items (not body.data) for the items array
- Returned object exposes { items, pageSize, total, page, totalPages }
- npx tsc --noEmit clean
- npm run build clean

---

## FIX 2 — Remove exam-session token gate in useSafeExamUsers

**File:** src/app/[locale]/(private)/manage-safeexamcenter/_components/useSafeExamUsers.ts (line ~40 — the enabled: !!token clause)

**Problem:**
The hook currently does:
  const { token } = useExamAuth()
  useQuery({ ..., enabled: !!token })

But GET /api/exam/admin/users is intentionally unauthenticated at the network layer.
The page-level admin gate lives in page.tsx (x-moso-user-id header/cookie — see task 2.7).
Admin users (loan officers/staff) do NOT have a SafeExamCenter exam-taker session cookie,
so token is always falsy, enabled stays false, the admin page is perpetually empty, and no request ever fires.

**Required changes (Option A — preferred):**
1. Delete the useExamAuth() import and call from this hook
2. Delete the enabled: !!token line from useQuery config (let the query run normally by default)
3. If getAdminExamUsers currently accepts a token argument at the call site here, drop that argument (pass undefined if signature still accepts optional token)
4. If src/apis/mosoAidApi.ts getAdminExamUsers currently REQUIRES a token parameter, relax it to token?: string | null and skip attaching any Authorization header when token is falsy (coordinate with FIX 1 — both go in the same commit)

**Do NOT:**

title: FE 2.2: Add useSafeExamFilterUrl hook (URL-as-source state)
description:
REPO: lf-homepage | BASE BRANCH: production | FEATURE BRANCH: feature/admin-safeexamcenter-results

FILE: new file src/app/[locale]/(private)/manage-safeexamcenter/_components/useSafeExamFilterUrl.ts

GOAL: Custom hook that reads/writes page, pageSize, and search to/from the URL via Next.js useSearchParams + useRouter. URL is the single source of truth — do NOT duplicate into useState + useEffect sync (project rule: feedback_url_as_source_pattern).

PATTERN REFERENCE: Follow the same approach as lf-iq's useUserFilterUrl pattern. The hook reads params from URL on mount, pushes updates to URL on change.

HOOK API:
type FilterState = { page: number; pageSize: number; search: string }
type HookReturn = FilterState & {
  setSearch: (v: string) => void   // must reset page to 1 when called
  setPage: (p: number) => void
  refreshNonce: number             // integer that increments on each refresh() call
  refresh: () => void              // increments refreshNonce — does NOT mutate URL
}

DEFAULTS: page=1, pageSize=20, search=''.
NAMING: Use 'pageSize' (NOT 'limit') per project convention feedback_pagesize_naming.

IMPLEMENTATION NOTES:
- Use Next.js useSearchParams() to read current URL params.
- Use useRouter() + router.push (or replace) to update params.
- setSearch resets page to 1 in the same URL update.
- refresh() increments a local useState counter (refreshNonce) — the data hook uses this in its query key to force a refetch.

CONVENTIONS:
- No semicolons.
- 'use client' directive at top if needed for useSearchParams.
- No inline style={{}}.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- Changing search updates URL and resets page to 1.
- Page reload preserves filters from URL.
- refresh() does not mutate URL but increments refreshNonce.
close_reason: Implemented useSafeExamFilterUrl hook in branch agent/8c88.2.2-safeexam-filter-url-hook (repo: lf-homepage). Hook reads page/pageSize/search from URL, exposes setSearch (resets page to 1), setPage, refresh (increments local nonce), and refreshNonce. URL is single source of truth. title: BE 1.3: Build aggregation service exam-admin.service.js
description:
REPO: moso-aid | BASE BRANCH: pro | FEATURE BRANCH: feature/admin-exam-results

FILE: new file src/services/exam-admin.service.js

GOAL: Pure data-layer function aggregateExamUsers({ page, limit, search }) that runs the MongoDB aggregation pipeline and returns { items, page, limit, total, totalPages }.

PIPELINE (implement exactly):
1. Optional $match stage: if search is truthy and non-whitespace, match { $or: [{ full_name: regex(search, i) }, { email: regex(search, i) }] }. Trim search and escape regex metacharacters (use a small inline escapeRegex helper — do NOT depend on lodash unless already in the repo).
2. $lookup against 'exams' collection using { let: { uid: '$_id' }, pipeline: [ match user_id eq uid, sort submitted_at -1, limit 3, project {_id:0, exam_id:'$_id', score, total_correct, total_questions, passed, status, submitted_at} ], as: 'last_3_results' }.
3. $addFields: last_exam_at = $cond(size(last_3_results) > 0, first element's submitted_at, null).
4. $sort: { last_exam_at: -1, _id: 1 } (stable tiebreaker; nulls sort after real values in MongoDB -1 direction).
5. $project: { _id:0, user_id:'$_id', full_name, email, exam_plan, last_exam_at, last_3_results }.
6. $facet: { items: [skip (page-1)*limit, limit N], meta: [count 'total'] }.
7. Call .allowDiskUse(true) on the aggregation.

OUTPUT SHAPE:
{ items: [...], page: number, limit: number, total: number, totalPages: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total/limit)) }

CONVENTIONS:
- No Express imports — pure service module.
- Named export: aggregateExamUsers only.
- File < 200 lines.
- Match existing service files style in src/services/.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- File exports aggregateExamUsers and nothing else.
- Manual smoke: calling with { page:1, limit:5 } returns correct shape.
- If search is empty/whitespace, no $match stage is added.

    SELECT h.id, h.full_name, h.email, COUNT(DISTINCT e.section_id) as viewed_section_count, COUNT(*) as total_event_count, MODE() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.section_id) as top_section
    FROM engagement_event e JOIN homeowner h ON h.id = e.homeowner_id JOIN engagement_score s ON s.homeowner_id = h.id
    WHERE e.occurred_at >= :since AND h.lo_id = :loId AND s.level = 'HIGH'
    GROUP BY h.id, h.full_name, h.email ORDER BY total_event_count DESC LIMIT 3

    RISING section - level-up homeowners - uses engagement_score_history table (see Task 2b):
    WITH last_two AS (SELECT homeowner_id, level, LAG(level) OVER (PARTITION BY homeowner_id ORDER BY computed_at) AS previous_level, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY homeowner_id ORDER BY computed_at DESC) AS rn FROM engagement_score_history WHERE computed_at >= :since)
    SELECT homeowner_id, previous_level, level AS current_level FROM last_two WHERE rn = 1 AND previous_level IS NOT NULL AND CASE level WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END > CASE previous_level WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END

    NEW VIEWERS section - first-time openers:

description:

WHAT TO DO:
Create the JWT-based unsubscribe token service and the public unsubscribe endpoint.

STEPS:
5.1 Create: lfiq-backend/src/main/java/com/loanfactory/lfiq/digest/util/UnsubscribeTokenService.java
    Reuse the existing JWT signing key from application.yml (do NOT create a new secret).

    public String issue(UUID userId) {
        return Jwts.builder()
            .subject(userId.toString())
            .claim("purpose", "digest_unsubscribe")
            .issuedAt(Date.from(Instant.now()))
            .expiration(Date.from(Instant.now().plus(Duration.ofDays(30))))
            .signWith(secretKey, Jwts.SIG.HS256)
            .compact();
    }

    public UUID verify(String token) {
        Claims claims = Jwts.parser()
            .verifyWith(secretKey).build()
            .parseSignedClaims(token).getPayload();
        if (!"digest_unsubscribe".equals(claims.get("purpose"))) {
            throw new InvalidTokenException();
        }
        return UUID.fromString(claims.getSubject());
    }

5.2 Create: lfiq-backend/src/main/java/com/loanfactory/lfiq/digest/controller/DigestUnsubscribeController.java

  // Skip if already shown this session
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return
  if (sessionStorage.getItem('rateCheckModal_autoShown') === 'true') return

  // Compute state — skip auto-popup for hidden/error/great-rate

  const timer = setTimeout(() => {

  return () => clearTimeout(timer)
}, [state, open])

title: T4 RateCheckCard — Option C state branching logic
description:
Implement the 4-state hybrid logic per Option C.

FILES: src/app/[locale]/(private)/[id]/_sections/RateCheckCard/index.tsx

STATE LOGIC (useMemo)
const state = useMemo(() => {
  if (isError) return 'error'
  if (isRefetching) return 'refreshing'
  if (!bestRateData || !currentMortgage) return 'hidden'

  const remainingBalance = currentMortgage.remaining_balance ?? currentMortgage.loan_balance ?? 0
  const rateDiff = (currentMortgage.interest_rate ?? 0) - (bestRateData.interest_rate ?? 0)
  const monthlySavings = (currentMortgage.monthly_payment ?? 0) - (bestRateData.monthly_payment ?? 0)

  if (remainingBalance <= 200000) return 'hidden'        // Cond 2 fail → hide
  if (rateDiff < 0.25) return 'great-rate'                // Cond 1 fail → great rate
  if (monthlySavings <= 0) return 'hidden'                // Cond 3 fail → hide
  return 'default'
}, [bestRateData, currentMortgage, isError, isRefetching])

if (state === 'hidden') return null

RENDER BRANCH
- default → savings hero + two rate cards + Get Quote CTA + secondary link
- great-rate → white bg, success accent, 'Talk to LO' CTA
- refreshing → skeleton variant
- error → error variant with retry button

ACCEPTANCE

- Hidden returns null
- Negative rateDiff (rate > current) → great-rate
- npm run build green

## Description
Implement the paginated TanStack Query hook that fetches engagement users with optional level/search filtering.

## File to create

## Exported interface and function
export interface UseEngagementUsersOptions {
  from: string | null
  to: string | null
  level: 'HIGH' | 'MEDIUM' | 'LOW' | null
  search: string
  page: number          // zero-based
  pageSize: number      // PROJECT MEMORY: must be pageSize, NOT limit
  sort?: string         // default 'totalSessionSeconds,desc'
}

export interface UseEngagementUsersResult {
  users: EngagementUserPage[]
  totalElements: number
  totalPages: number
  isLoading: boolean
  isFetching: boolean
  isError: boolean
  refetch: () => void
}

export function useEngagementUsers(options: UseEngagementUsersOptions): UseEngagementUsersResult

## Implementation rules
- Wrap getEngagementUsers({ pageSize, currentPage: page, level, search: search.trim() || undefined, from, to, sort }).
- When search is empty string OR whitespace-only, do NOT include the param in the request (pass undefined).
- When level is null, do NOT include the param in the request.
- useQuery with queryKey: ['engagement-users', { from, to, level, search: trimmed, page, pageSize, sort }].
- Parse paginated envelope: result.payload (array) + result.page ({ totalElements, totalPages, currentPage, pageSize }). Default to empty array + 0 counts on missing.

title: [FE][hook] 2.2 Implement useEngagementOverview
description:
## Description
Implement the TanStack Query hook that fetches both getStatisticsSnapshot and getEngagementOverview in parallel and normalizes the results.

## File to create
src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/engagement/_v2/_hooks/useEngagementOverview.ts

## Exported interface and function
export interface EngagementStats {
  totalHomeowners: number
  avgEngagementScore: number
  activeToday: number
  avgSessionSeconds: number
}

export interface UseEngagementOverviewResult {
  stats: EngagementStats | null
  overview: EngagementOverview | null   // from @shared/types/engagement-types
  isLoading: boolean
  isFetching: boolean
  isError: boolean
  refetch: () => void
}

export function useEngagementOverview(filter: { from: string | null; to: string | null }): UseEngagementOverviewResult

## Implementation rules
- Build engagement filter string:
  ['user_role eq "HOMEOWNER"', from && `last_engaged_at gte ""`, to && `last_engaged_at lte ""`].filter(Boolean).join(' and ')
- useQuery with queryKey: ['engagement-overview', { from, to }]. queryFn calls Promise.all([getStatisticsSnapshot('ENGAGEMENT', { filter }), getEngagementOverview({ from, to })]).
- Parse snapshot into EngagementStats using:
  function parseStatsFromSnapshot(metrics: { key: string; value: number }[]): EngagementStats {
    const map = new Map(metrics.map(m => [m.key, m.value]))
    return {
      totalHomeowners: map.get('TOTAL_HOMEOWNERS') ?? 0,
      avgEngagementScore: map.get('AVG_ENGAGEMENT_SCORE') ?? 0,
      activeToday: map.get('ACTIVE_TODAY') ?? 0,
      avgSessionSeconds: map.get('AVG_SESSION_SECONDS') ?? 0
    }
  }
- Options: placeholderData: previous, staleTime: 15_000, refetchOnWindowFocus: false.
- On 4xx/5xx: surface isError: true, return null for stats and overview.

## API helpers (from @apis/private-api)
- getStatisticsSnapshot('ENGAGEMENT', { filter: string })
- getEngagementOverview({ from: string | null, to: string | null })

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Returns { stats, overview, isLoading, isFetching, isError, refetch }.
- [ ] isFetching becomes true during a refetch while previous data stays visible (placeholderData: previous).
- [ ] Unit test: mocked snapshot with [{key:'TOTAL_HOMEOWNERS', value:6500}, ...] parses correctly into stats.
- [ ] Unit test: when both API calls reject, isError === true AND stats === null && overview === null.
- [ ] npx tsc --noEmit passes.

## Reference
- Canonical hook pattern: src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/users/_v2/_hooks/useUsersV2.ts
- API types: src/shared/types/engagement-types.ts
- API helpers: src/apis/private-api.ts

## Branch
- Branch FROM production (NOT master)
- Branch name: agent/<bead-id>-use-engagement-overview
- Commit format: feat: 2.2 implement useEngagementOverview [<bead-id>]

## Constraints
- TypeScript strict mode
- placeholderData: previous (so data dims instead of disappears on refresh)
- staleTime: 15_000, refetchOnWindowFocus: false — match canonical pattern

Hook fetches getStatisticsSnapshot + getEngagementOverview in parallel via Promise.all, exports parseStatsFromSnapshot, uses placeholderData: previous / staleTime: 15_000 / refetchOnWindowFocus: false. title: [FE][hook] 2.1 Implement useEngagementFilterUrl
description:
## Description
Implement the URL-as-source filter hook for the admin Engagement page. Mirror the structure of src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/users/_v2/_hooks/useUserFilterUrl.ts.

## File to create
src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/engagement/_v2/_hooks/useEngagementFilterUrl.ts

(This file was scaffolded as empty in task 1.1 — replace the placeholder with the real implementation.)

## Exported types and functions
export type EngagementRange = '7d' | '30d' | '90d' | 'custom'

export interface EngagementFilterValues {
  range: EngagementRange
  from: string | null
  to: string | null
}

export const DEFAULT_ENGAGEMENT_FILTER_VALUES: EngagementFilterValues = {
  range: '30d',
  from: null,
  to: null
}

export const parseFilterValuesFromSearchParams: (sp: URLSearchParams) => EngagementFilterValues
export const serializeFilterValuesToSearchParams: (v: EngagementFilterValues) => URLSearchParams

export const useEngagementFilterUrl: () => {
  values: EngagementFilterValues
  setValues: (next: EngagementFilterValues) => void
  setRange: (range: EngagementRange) => void
  setCustomRange: (from: string | null, to: string | null) => void
  reset: () => void
}

## Implementation rules
- Whitelist range against ['7d', '30d', '90d', 'custom']; invalid value → fallback '30d'.
- Validate from / to against /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/; invalid → null. Only honour from/to when range === 'custom'; otherwise drop them in the serializer.
- Serializer omits values equal to default to keep URLs canonical (e.g. range='30d' → no ?range= param).
- useEngagementFilterUrl reads via useSearchParams(), writes via useRouter().replace(url, { scroll: false }) — NO useState, NO useEffect sync.
- setRange('custom') keeps existing from/to. setRange('7d' | '30d' | '90d') clears from/to.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Hook + helpers exported per the signatures above.
- [ ] Setting range='7d' updates URL to ?range=7d; setting back to '30d' removes the param entirely.
- [ ] Manually pasting ?range=invalid resolves to '30d'.
- [ ] At least one unit test covers parse + serialize round-trip and the invalid → default fallback.

Repo: lf-iq | Conventions: Tailwind only (không dùng Mantine), useTranslations(), null-safe với optional chaining

## Mục tiêu
Tạo helper file chứa action color map cho AuditTab v2. Đây là foundation task — AuditTab và ModalV2 đều import từ file này.

## File cần tạo (MỚI)
`lf-iq/src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/users/_v2/_utils/auditPalette.ts`

## Implementation (verbatim từ design.md)
```ts
export const ACTION_CHIP_CLASSES: Record<string, string> = {
  CREATE: 'bg-[#ECFDF5] text-[#047857]',
  UPDATE: 'bg-[#DBEAFE] text-[#1D4ED8]',
  DELETE: 'bg-[#FEF2F2] text-[#B91C1C]',
  LOGIN:  'bg-[#FFF7ED] text-[#C2410C]',
  LOGOUT: 'bg-[#F3F4F6] text-[#4B5563]'
}
export const DEFAULT_ACTION_CHIP_CLASS = 'bg-[#F3F4F6] text-[#4B5563]'
export const ACTION_DOT_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  CREATE: '#10B981', UPDATE: '#3B82F6', DELETE: '#EF4444',
  LOGIN:  '#F59E0B', LOGOUT: '#9CA3AF'
}
export const DEFAULT_ACTION_DOT_COLOR = '#9CA3AF'
export const getActionChipClass = (action: string | null | undefined): string => {
  if (!action) return DEFAULT_ACTION_CHIP_CLASS
  return ACTION_CHIP_CLASSES[action.toUpperCase()] ?? DEFAULT_ACTION_CHIP_CLASS
}
export const getActionDotColor = (action: string | null | undefined): string => {
  if (!action) return DEFAULT_ACTION_DOT_COLOR
  return ACTION_DOT_COLORS[action.toUpperCase()] ?? DEFAULT_ACTION_DOT_COLOR
}
```

## Visual Reference
Mockup.html: xem phần chip màu sắc trên AuditTab timeline rows (panel bên trái)

- File tồn tại tại path trên

- getActionChipClass('create'), getActionChipClass('CREATE'), getActionChipClass(null) đều return string
- Hai cái đầu return green class bg-[#ECFDF5] text-[#047857], cái sau return default

import { IconSparkles, IconLayoutDashboard } from "@tabler/icons-react";
import { useAtom } from "jotai";
import { Tooltip, ActionIcon } from "@mantine/core";
import { uiVersionAtom } from "@jotai/atom/uiVersionState";

</Tooltip>

## Task 1.2 — useAutoScrollOnMobile hook

**Repo**: lf-iq
**Base branch**: feature/redesign-export-database-v2

## File to create

`lf-iq/src/hooks/useAutoScrollOnMobile.ts`

## Implementation

```ts
import { useEffect, RefObject } from 'react'

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT_PX = 768

export function useAutoScrollOnMobile<T extends HTMLElement>(
  ref: RefObject<T>,
  trigger: unknown
): void {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!trigger || !ref.current) return
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return
    if (window.innerWidth >= MOBILE_BREAKPOINT_PX) return
    ref.current.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' })
  }, [trigger, ref])
}
```

## Acceptance
- TypeScript types correct; strict mode compiles.
- SSR-safe (`typeof window` guard).
- No-op when viewport ≥ 768px.
- `npm run build` passes; `npm run lint` clean.

title: Wire all modals into ReferralPartnersPage and verify end-to-end
description:
## Task: Wire all modals into ReferralPartnersPage and verify end-to-end

**Target repo:** lf-iq
**Feature branch:** feature/referral-partners-v2
**File to verify/modify:** src/app/[locale]/(private)/referral-partners-v2/_components/ReferralPartnersPage/index.tsx

### What to do

Ensure all 5 v2 modals are properly imported, rendered, and wired into the main ReferralPartnersPage. Verify every interaction works end-to-end.

### Verification checklist

1. **Modal imports:** Verify ReferralPartnersPage imports all 5 v2 modals:
   - AddPartnerModal from '../AddPartnerModal'
   - InvitePartnerModal from '../InvitePartnerModal'
   - UserInfoModal from '../UserInfoModal'
   - DefaultRealtorModal from '../DefaultRealtorModal'
   (SelectRealtorModal is used internally by DefaultRealtorModal, not imported here)

2. **Modal hooks:** Verify useModal is called for each:
   ```tsx
   const addPartnerModal = useModal(AddPartnerModal)
   const invitePartnerModal = useModal(InvitePartnerModal)
   const userInfoModal = useModal(UserInfoModal)
   const defaultRealtorModal = useModal(DefaultRealtorModal)
   ```

3. **Toolbar triggers:** Verify PartnersToolbar handlers:
   - onAddPartner opens addPartnerModal
   - onInvitePartner opens invitePartnerModal
   - onManageDefaultRealtor opens defaultRealtorModal

4. **Card triggers:** Verify PartnerCard:
   - Avatar/name click opens userInfoModal with partner data

5. **Modal callbacks:** Verify modals receive onRefresh callback:
   ```tsx
   // Each modal should get onRefresh that re-fetches partner list
   addPartnerModal.open({ onRefresh: fetchReferralPartners })
   ```

6. **Data refresh:** After modal actions (invite sent, default realtor saved), the partner list should refresh

### Full flow verification

Test these user flows work:
1. Load page → data appears from API
2. Type in search → debounced search updates results
3. Select source filter → results filter by source
4. Select status filter → results filter by status
5. Select date range → results filter by date
6. Click Clear → all filters reset
7. Click Refresh icon → data reloads
8. Expand a partner card → report table shows
9. Click copy link in report table → clipboard copy with visual feedback
10. Click partner avatar → UserInfoModal opens with partner data
11. Click "Add Partner" button → AddPartnerModal opens
12. Click "Invite Partner" button → InvitePartnerModal opens
13. Click "Manage Default Realtor" button → DefaultRealtorModal opens
14. Change page → pagination updates data

### Build verification

Run npm run build and verify:
- No TypeScript errors
- No missing imports
- No unused imports
- All v2 components properly connected

### Acceptance criteria

- All 5 modals open and function correctly from v2 page
- Data refreshes after mutations (invite, save default realtor)
- No TypeScript errors
- Full user flow works end-to-end
- All modal props correctly passed (partner data, refresh callbacks, user profile)
- npm run build passes
close_reason: Already implemented in feature/referral-partners-v2 branch. All 4 modals (Add, Invite, UserInfo, DefaultRealtor) are wired in ReferralPartnersPage/index.tsx. Build passes cleanly.

This is the most complex modal — it manages default realtor assignment, state exceptions, SELF assignment, and integrates with SelectRealtorModal. ### Reference file (v1 to port from) src/app/[locale]/(private)/referral-partners/_components/DefaultRealtorModal/index.tsx (820 lines). Port ALL logic including: - Form management with react-hook-form + joiResolver - Default realtor selection (SELF, specific realtor, or none) - State exceptions (per-state realtor overrides) - ALL/OTHER assignment logic - API calls: getUserProfile, updateUserProfile - Jotai atoms: referralPartnersState, userProfileState - Integration with SelectRealtorModal (v2 version from task 4.5) ### Key types to preserve ```tsx type DefaultRealtorInfo = { key: string first_name: string last_name: string email: string avatar?: string isSelf?: boolean } interface StateException { stateCode: string stateName: string realtorKey: string } interface DefaultRealtorModalProps { modalState: IMantineModalState onRefresh?: () => Promise } ``` ### V2 visual changes (apply to all rendered elements) **Modal props:** size="xl", radius="md" **Title:** ```tsx {t('Referral.manage_default_realtor')} ``` **Default realtor card:** ```tsx
{defaultRealtor?.first_name} {defaultRealtor?.last_name} {defaultRealtor?.email}
``` **State exception items (Paper equivalent):** ```tsx
{/* State name + realtor info + remove button */}
``` **"Not Assigned" states section:** ```tsx
{stateName}
``` **Add state exception buttons:** Use v2 button styling with radius="md" **Footer:** Cancel + Save buttons - Cancel: variant="outline" radius="md" - Save: variant="filled" radius="md" color="orange" ### SelectRealtorModal integration Import the v2 SelectRealtorModal from the same v2 directory: ```tsx import SelectRealtorModal from '../SelectRealtorModal' ``` Use the same useModal pattern to open SelectRealtorModal when changing default realtor or adding state exceptions. ### Critical: keep under 500 lines The v1 is 820 lines. To fit under 500: - Extract helper functions (buildFormData, parseProfileData) to the top of the file - Use more compact Tailwind JSX (fewer wrapper divs than v1's Mantine Stack/Group/Divider) - Consider extracting the state exception list into a small local sub-component if needed ### Imports needed ```tsx import { joiResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/joi' import { Avatar, Button, Modal, ScrollArea } from '@mantine/core' import { IconPlus, IconUserPin, IconX } from '@tabler/icons-react' import { useAtom, useSetAtom } from 'jotai' import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl' import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react' import { useForm, useWatch } from 'react-hook-form' import { STATES } from '@constants/address-types' import { IMAGES } from '@constants/image-url' import { referralPartnersState, userProfileState } from '@jotai/atom/userProfileState' import { isLoanOfficerProfile } from '@shared/types/user' import { getReferralPartners, getUserProfile, updateUserProfile } from '@apis/private-api' import useModal from '@hooks/modal/useModal' import type { IMantineModalState } from '@hooks/modal/useModal' import useToast from '@hooks/useToast' import { extractErrorMessage } from '@utils/errorUtils' import { object, string, array } from '@utils/joiShorthandTypes' import { formatUpdateUserProfileBody } from '@utils/user' import SelectRealtorModal from '../SelectRealtorModal' ``` ### Conventions - All text via useTranslations() - No Mantine Stack/Group/Text/Title/Paper/Divider — use divs + Tailwind - Mantine form controls (Button, Avatar, Modal, ScrollArea) are OK - Null-safe throughout - Use existing joiResolver pattern for form validation ### Acceptance criteria - Same full functionality as v1: set default realtor, add state exceptions, assign/unassign, save to profile - SELF assignment works (assign current user as default realtor) - ALL/OTHER assignment logic preserved - State exception CRUD (add, change realtor, remove) works - Opens v2 SelectRealtorModal for realtor selection - Save calls updateUserProfile API correctly - V2 visual styling throughout (rounded-12 borders, consistent spacing, no Mantine layout components) - Under 500 lines - npm run build passes

Study the homeowners-v2 version at: src/app/[locale]/(private)/homeowners-v2/_components/ReportColumnsConfig.tsx (420 lines). Adapt the pattern but with referral-partner-specific columns.

```tsx
export function useReportColumns(): MRT_ColumnDef<any>[] {

  const router = useRouter()
  const [copiedId, setCopiedId] = useState<string>('')
  // ... return useMemo(() => [...columns], [t, router, copiedId])

```

### Column definitions (4 columns)

- Property thumbnail: classes "w-16 min-w-16 h-auto rounded-md"

description:
## Task: Set up version switching in referral-partners/page.tsx

**Target repo:** lf-iq
**Feature branch:** feature/referral-partners-v2
**File to modify:** src/app/[locale]/(private)/referral-partners/page.tsx

### What to do

Replace the direct import of v1 ReferralPartners with the withUIVersion HOC pattern that lazy-loads either v1 or v2 based on the uiVersionAtom Jotai atom.

### New code (exact implementation)

```tsx
'use client'

import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation'
import type { UserStatus } from '@shared/types/user'
import RouteGuard from '@shared/components/RouteGuard'
import { withUIVersion } from '@shared/components/withUIVersion'

interface ReferralPartnersPageProps {
  initialStatus?: UserStatus
  initialSource?: 'LF' | 'LFIQ'
}

const ReferralPartners = withUIVersion<ReferralPartnersPageProps>(
  () => import('./_components/ReferralPartners'),
  () => import('../referral-partners-v2/_components/ReferralPartnersPage')
)

export default function ReferralPartnersPage() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams()
  const statusFromUrl = searchParams.get('status') as UserStatus | null
  const sourceFromUrl = searchParams.get('source') as 'LF' | 'LFIQ' | null

  return (
    <RouteGuard requiredRoles={['LOAN_OFFICER', 'ADMIN']}>
      <ReferralPartners
        initialStatus={statusFromUrl || undefined}
        initialSource={sourceFromUrl || undefined}
      />
    </RouteGuard>
  )
}
```

### Reference pattern

Follow the exact pattern used in src/app/[locale]/(private)/homeowners/page.tsx — it uses the same withUIVersion HOC.

### Acceptance criteria

- When uiVersionAtom === 'v2', the v2 component lazy-loads from referral-partners-v2/_components/ReferralPartnersPage
- When uiVersionAtom === 'v1' (default), the existing v1 component loads unchanged
- npm run build passes with no TypeScript errors

title: Add 301 redirect in middleware for old branch slugs
description:
## Task: Add 301 redirect in middleware for old branch slugs

**Target repo:** lf-homepage
**Feature branch:** feature/seo-branch-detail
**Complexity:** Medium (sonnet)

### What to do

1. In `src/middleware.ts`, add a new function `tryBranchSlugRedirect(request: NextRequest): NextResponse | null`.

2. The function logic:
   - Match pathnames like `/{optional-locale}/branches/{slug}` where `{slug}` is not empty
   - Strip the optional locale prefix (reuse the same pattern as `tryFindLoanOfficersRedirect` -- split by '/', check if first segment is in LOCALES)
   - After the `branches` segment, extract the slug
   - Extract the branch ID from the slug: `slug.split('-').slice(-1)[0]`
   - Check if the slug already starts with a 2-letter state prefix: `/^[a-z]{2}-/.test(slug)`. If yes, return `null` (no redirect needed -- already new format)
   - If the slug does NOT start with a state prefix (old format like `houston-727787009`):
     a. Fetch branch data by ID using a direct `fetch` call:
        `${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MOSO_API_URL}/api/webplus/v1/5716104026521600/getBranchLocationInfo?id=${branchId}`
        (Do NOT import `fetchBranchById` -- middleware runs in Edge runtime. The namespace `5716104026521600` is the LOANFACTORY_NS constant.)
     b. If fetch fails or returns an error (check `body.error`), return `null` (let the page handle 404)
     c. Build the new geographic slug by inlining the slug logic:
        ```typescript
        const stateSlug = branch.state.trim().toLowerCase()
        const citySlug = branch.name
          .trim()
          .normalize('NFD')
          .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
          .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\s-]/g, '')
          .toLowerCase()
          .replace(/\s+/g, '-')
          .replace(/-+/g, '-')
          .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')
        const newSlug = `${stateSlug}-${citySlug}-${branch.id}`
        ```
        NOTE: Inline the `formatSlugName` logic rather than importing from `@utils/format`, because that module imports `@constants/social-links` at the top level which may not be Edge-compatible. If you determine `@utils/format` IS Edge-safe (it only uses string operations), you can import `formatSlugName` directly instead.
     d. Build the redirect URL preserving locale prefix if present
     e. Return `NextResponse.redirect(redirectUrl, { status: 301 })`

3. Call `tryBranchSlugRedirect(request)` in the main `middleware` function, AFTER the `tryFindLoanOfficersRedirect` call (around line 197) and BEFORE the pathname lowercase conversion and i18n routing (around line 205).

Insert it like this:
```typescript
// Redirect old branch slugs to new geographic format (301)
const branchRedirect = tryBranchSlugRedirect(request)
if (branchRedirect) {
  return branchRedirect
}
```

### Files to modify
- `src/middleware.ts` -- add `tryBranchSlugRedirect` function and call it in the middleware chain

### Reference: existing middleware structure
The middleware function currently (in order):
1. OPTIONS handling
2. Domain whitelist check
3. Sitemap/robots exclusion
4. Static asset exclusion (_next, images, webplus-api)
5. `tryRedirect` (old page URLs)
6. Release page check
7. `tryFindLoanOfficersRedirect` (LO URL format normalization)
8. Add searchParams to headers
9. Lowercase pathname
10. i18n routing

Insert the branch redirect between steps 7 and 8.

### Code style
- No semicolons
- No trailing commas
- Match the style of existing `tryFindLoanOfficersRedirect` function
- Max 500 lines per file (current file is ~212 lines, adding ~40-50 lines is fine)

### Acceptance criteria
- Request to `/branches/houston-727787009` returns 301 redirect to `/branches/tx-houston-727787009`
- Request to `/branches/tx-houston-727787009` passes through without redirect
- Request to `/branches/invalid-999` does not crash (returns null, page handles 404)
- Request to `/es/branches/houston-727787009` redirects to `/es/branches/tx-houston-727787009` (locale preserved)
- Build passes (`npm run build`)

### Dependencies
Task agentflow-air.1 (formatBranchSlug utility must exist -- though this task inlines the logic rather than importing it, the slug format must be consistent)
close_reason: 301 redirect

title: Unit test: verify related_user_keys excludes HOME_OWNER after filter
description:
## Task
Add a unit test verifying that the related_user_keys filter logic correctly excludes HOME_OWNER profiles from the form population.

## Target Repo
lf-iq (Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Mantine 7)

## Important Context: No Existing Test Infrastructure
lf-iq has jest 29 as a devDependency but NO jest config, NO test script in package.json, and ZERO existing test files. You will need to:
1. Create a jest.config.ts (or jest.config.js) appropriate for Next.js 14 + TypeScript
2. Add a 'test' script to package.json: "test": "jest"
3. Ensure ts-jest or @swc/jest is configured for TypeScript support
4. Consider adding @testing-library/react if not already installed (check package.json first)

## Approach: Test the Filter Logic in Isolation
Rather than rendering the full ReportForm component (which has heavy dependencies), extract and test the filter logic as a pure function. Create a utility function or test the logic inline.

The filter logic to test:
(data.related_users || [])
  .filter((user: any) => user.current_profile !== 'HOME_OWNER')
  .map((user: any) => user.key)
  .filter((key: any) => key != null) || []

## Test File
Create: src/app/[locale]/(private)/homeowners/_components/ReportForm/__tests__/related-user-keys-filter.test.ts

## Test Scenarios
1. Given related_users contains [LO, Realtor, HomeOwner1, HomeOwner2] (with current_profile set), the filtered result should contain only [LO_key, Realtor_key].
2. Given related_users contains only [LO, Realtor] (no homeowners), the result should be [LO_key, Realtor_key] -- unchanged.
3. Given related_users is empty array or null/undefined, the result should be an empty array (no crash).
4. Given a user with null/undefined current_profile, their key should still be included (conservative: only exclude explicit 'HOME_OWNER').
5. Given a user with current_profile 'HOME_OWNER' but null key, they should be excluded (both filters apply).

## Feature Branch
fixbug/fix-co-homeowner-removal (base branch in lf-iq repo)

## Acceptance Criteria
- All 5 test scenarios pass
- Jest runs successfully with the new config
- npm run build still passes (test setup doesnt break build)
- One commit: test: verify related_user_keys excludes HOME_OWNER keys [BEAD_ID]

```sql
BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS onboarding_workflows (
    id              VARCHAR(36)  NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()::text,
    user_id         VARCHAR(36)  NOT NULL,
    state           JSONB        NOT NULL DEFAULT '{

);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_onboarding_user_id ON onboarding_workflows (user_id);

COMMIT;
```

title: Create Joi validation schemas for edit user forms
description:
## Context
Feature: admin-edit-user-profile (lf-iq repo)
Depends on: agentflow-esb.1 (TypeScript interfaces must exist first)

## What to do
Create a new file at:
`lf-iq/src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/users/_components/EditUserDrawer/validation.ts`

## Pattern to follow
Exact same pattern as `lf-iq/src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/cron-jobs/_components/UpdateCronJobModal/index.tsx`:
- Import from `@utils/joiShorthandTypes` (located at `lf-iq/src/shared/utils/joiShorthandTypes.ts`)
- joiShorthandTypes exports: `string`, `object`, `number`, `boolean`, `array`, `email`, `nmls`, `date`
- Schemas are compatible with `joiResolver` from `@hookform/resolvers/joi`

## Schemas to create

```typescript
import { string, object, number, boolean, array, email } from '@utils/joiShorthandTypes'

// Base schema - required for all profile types
export const baseUserSchema = object.keys({
  email: email.required().label('Email'),
  first_name: string.required().label('First Name'),
  last_name: string.required().label('Last Name'),
  phone: string.allow('', null).label('Phone'),
  avatar: string.allow('', null).label('Avatar'),
  date_of_birth: string.allow('', null).label('Date of Birth'),
  gender: string.valid('MALE', 'FEMALE', 'UNKNOWN').allow('', null).label('Gender'),
})

export const homeOwnerProfileSchema = object.keys({
  type: string.valid('HOME_OWNER').required(),
  ho_working_with_lo_key: string.allow('', null),
  ho_worked_with_realtor_keys: array.items(string).default([]),
  ho_invited_by_key: string.allow('', null),
})

export const loanOfficerProfileSchema = object.keys({
  type: string.valid('LOAN_OFFICER').required(),
  company_email: string.allow('', null),
  company_phone: string.allow('', null),
  nmls: string.allow('', null),
  licensed_states: array.items(string).default([]),
  has_real_estate_license: boolean.default(false),
  re_company: string.allow('', null),
  re_company_address: string.allow('', null),
  company_domain_url: string.allow('', null),
  personal_domain_url: string.allow('', null),
  lf_company_domain_url: string.allow('', null),
  lf_personal_domain_url: string.allow('', null),
  closed_loans_per_month: number,
  closed_loans_per_quarter: number,
  closed_loans_per_year: number,
})

export const realtorProfileSchema = object.keys({
  type: string.valid('REALTOR').required(),
  licensed_states: array.items(string).default([]),
  realtor_working_with_lo_key: string.allow('', null),
  organization: string.allow('', null),
  realtor_worked_with_lo_keys: array.items(string).default([]),
})

export function getEditUserSchema(profileType: string) {
  let profileSchema = homeOwnerProfileSchema
  if (profileType === 'LOAN_OFFICER') profileSchema = loanOfficerProfileSchema
  else if (profileType === 'REALTOR') profileSchema = realtorProfileSchema

  return baseUserSchema.keys({
    profile: profileSchema.required(),
  })
}
```

## Notes
- re_company_licenses, re_licenses, default_realtor_by_state (complex nested structures) are omitted from validation — they are preserved as-is from original user data in the submit handler
- The `nmls` shorthand from joiShorthandTypes applies pattern /^[1-9][0-9]{3,11}$/ — use plain `string.allow('', null)` instead to allow any string

title: Implement full state/city name slugs for find-loan-officers URLs
description:
Project: lf-homepage (Next.js 14, App Router, TypeScript)
Branch: agent/<bead-id>-state-city-slug-full-name (base from 'production' branch of lf-homepage repo)

## Problem
Currently state filter URLs use abbreviations like /find-loan-officers/TX which is unclear to users. City URLs like /find-loan-officers/TX/Houston also use abbreviations.

## Goal
Change all state/city URL slugs to use full names with hyphens for spaces:
- State: /find-loan-officers/Texas (not /TX)
- City: /find-loan-officers/Texas/Houston or /find-loan-officers/Texas/Texas-City
- Hyphens (-) for spaces, never underscores or %20

## Files to Modify

### 1. Create slug utility: lf-homepage/src/utils/stateSlug.ts (or similar)
```ts
// Map of state abbreviations to full names
const STATE_ABBREV_TO_NAME: Record<string, string> = {
  AL: 'Alabama', AK: 'Alaska', AZ: 'Arizona', AR: 'Arkansas',
  CA: 'California', CO: 'Colorado', CT: 'Connecticut', DE: 'Delaware',
  FL: 'Florida', GA: 'Georgia', HI: 'Hawaii', ID: 'Idaho',
  IL: 'Illinois', IN: 'Indiana', IA: 'Iowa', KS: 'Kansas',
  KY: 'Kentucky', LA: 'Louisiana', ME: 'Maine', MD: 'Maryland',
  MA: 'Massachusetts', MI: 'Michigan', MN: 'Minnesota', MS: 'Mississippi',
  MO: 'Missouri', MT: 'Montana', NE: 'Nebraska', NV: 'Nevada',
  NH: 'New Hampshire', NJ: 'New Jersey', NM: 'New Mexico', NY: 'New York',
  NC: 'North Carolina', ND: 'North Dakota', OH: 'Ohio', OK: 'Oklahoma',
  OR: 'Oregon', PA: 'Pennsylvania', RI: 'Rhode Island', SC: 'South Carolina',
  SD: 'South Dakota', TN: 'Tennessee', TX: 'Texas', UT: 'Utah',
  VT: 'Vermont', VA: 'Virginia', WA: 'Washington', WV: 'West Virginia',
  WI: 'Wisconsin', WY: 'Wyoming', DC: 'District of Columbia'
}

// Convert a state abbreviation or name to a URL slug
// e.g., 'TX' -> 'Texas', 'New York' -> 'New-York'
export function toStateSlug(state: string): string
// e.g., 'Texas' -> 'Texas', 'New-York' -> 'New York'  
export function fromStateSlug(slug: string): string
// e.g., 'Texas City' -> 'Texas-City', 'houston' -> 'houston'
export function toCitySlug(city: string): string
// e.g., 'Texas-City' -> 'Texas City'
export function fromCitySlug(slug: string): string
```

Rules for slug generation:
- Replace spaces with hyphens (-)
- Do NOT lowercase (keep original case: 'Texas' not 'texas', 'New-York' not 'new-york')
- Remove/encode only truly invalid URL chars (keep letters, digits, hyphens)
- If input is an abbreviation (2-letter uppercase like 'TX'), expand to full name first

### 2. Update state page: lf-homepage/src/app/[locale]/(public)/find-loan-officers/[state]/page.tsx
- In loadStateListing: use fromStateSlug(stateParam) to get the real state name for API queries
- In buildListingUrl: use toStateSlug(state) for generating canonical URLs
- Update generateStaticParams if present to output full state name slugs

### 3. Update city page: lf-homepage/src/app/[locale]/(public)/find-loan-officers/[state]/[city]/page.tsx
- Replace current decodePath with fromCitySlug for city, fromStateSlug for state
- Update buildListingUrl to use toCitySlug/toStateSlug
- The current decodePath replaces _ with spaces — replace this with fromCitySlug

### 4. Update Filters component (if it generates state/city navigation links)
- File: lf-homepage/src/app/[locale]/(public)/find-loan-officers/_sections/LoanOfficerSection/Filters/index.tsx
- Ensure any href/link that navigates to /find-loan-officers/{state} uses toStateSlug()

### 5. Add 301 redirects for old abbreviation URLs
In lf-homepage, add a Next.js redirect in next.config.mjs:
```js
// Redirect /find-loan-officers/TX -> /find-loan-officers/Texas
// Redirect /find-loan-officers/TX/Houston -> /find-loan-officers/Texas/Houston
// Add redirects for all 50 state abbreviations
```
OR handle in middleware.ts: detect if [state] param matches a 2-letter abbreviation, then redirect to full name slug.

IMPORTANT: Prefer middleware-based redirect over next.config.mjs if there are 50+ state entries to avoid bloating the config file.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Navigating to /find-loan-officers/Texas shows correct listing for Texas
2. Navigating to /find-loan-officers/Texas/Houston shows correct city listing
3. Navigating to old /find-loan-officers/TX returns 301 redirect to /Texas
4. Spaces in city/state names use hyphens: /find-loan-officers/New-York/New-York-City
5. API queries receive the correct decoded state/city values (not slugged versions)
6. Canonical URLs generated by buildListingUrl use full-name slugs
7. No TypeScript errors (npx tsc --noEmit passes)
close_reason: Full state/city name slugs + 301 redirects from 2-letter abbreviation URLs via middleware

title: 2.2 Create reusable useSavedFilters(target) hook
description:
REPO: lf-iq | BRANCH: agent/<bead-id>-use-saved-filters from feature/saved-filters

DEPENDS ON: task 2.1 (API types and functions must exist)

FILE TO CREATE:
  src/shared/hooks/useSavedFilters.ts

REFERENCE:
  - src/apis/private-api.ts (listSavedFilters, createSavedFilter, updateSavedFilter, deleteSavedFilter)
  - Existing TanStack Query hooks in the repo for query/mutation patterns
  - useUserProfile() hook — provides .id (the REAL admin user id, login-as safe)
  - useToast() hook — provides notifySuccess, notifyError
  - useTranslations('SavedFilters') — for toast messages (added in task 2.3)

IMPLEMENTATION:

import { useQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { useTranslations } from 'next-intl'
import { useUserProfile } from '...'  // real admin user
import { useToast } from '...'
import { listSavedFilters, createSavedFilter, updateSavedFilter, deleteSavedFilter } from '@/apis/private-api'
import type { SavedFilter, CreateSavedFilterBody, UpdateSavedFilterBody } from '@/apis/private-api'

export function useSavedFilters(target: string) {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient()
  const t = useTranslations('SavedFilters')
  const { notifySuccess, notifyError } = useToast()
  const { id: userId } = useUserProfile()  // REAL user id, not impersonated

  const queryKey = ['saved-filters', target, userId]

  const { data: presets = [], isLoading } = useQuery({
    queryKey,
    queryFn: () => listSavedFilters(target),
    enabled: !!userId,
  })

  const defaultPreset = presets.find(p => p.is_default) ?? null

  const invalidate = () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey })

  const createMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (body: CreateSavedFilterBody) => createSavedFilter(body),
    onSuccess: () => { invalidate(); notifySuccess(t('saved_success')) },
    onError: () => notifyError(t('error_generic')),
  })

  const updateMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: ({ id, body }: { id: string; body: UpdateSavedFilterBody }) => updateSavedFilter(id, body),
    onSuccess: () => { invalidate(); notifySuccess(t('updated_success')) },
    onError: () => notifyError(t('error_generic')),
  })

  const deleteMutation = useMutation({
    mutationFn: (id: string) => deleteSavedFilter(id),
    onSuccess: () => { invalidate(); notifySuccess(t('deleted_success')) },
    onError: () => notifyError(t('error_generic')),
  })

  const setDefault = (id: string) =>
    updateMutation.mutate({ id, body: { is_default: true } })  // toast: default_set_success

  // For setDefault toast: use default_set_success message — override onSuccess for the setDefault wrapper

  return {
    presets,
    defaultPreset,
    isLoading: isLoading || createMutation.isPending || updateMutation.isPending || deleteMutation.isPending,
    createPreset: (body: CreateSavedFilterBody) => createMutation.mutate(body),
    updatePreset: (id: string, body: UpdateSavedFilterBody) => updateMutation.mutate({ id, body }),
    deletePreset: (id: string) => deleteMutation.mutate(id),
    setDefault,
  }
}

NOTE: setDefault should show 'default_set_success' toast, not 'updated_success'. Either use a separate mutation with different onSuccess, or accept a flag param to customize the success message.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- npx tsc --noEmit clean
- Cache queryKey includes userId (so impersonation does not cross caches)
- Cache invalidates after each mutation
- All 4 mutations wire to the correct API functions
close_reason: Implemented useSavedFilters hook with 4 mutations (create/update/setDefault/delete). tsc clean, build passes.

title: Fix import/order lint errors in ActivityHeatmap and EngagementToolbar (engagement-v2)
description:
## Bug: Import order lint errors in 2 shared components

**Detected by:** T9 verification pass

**Files with new lint errors (not present on production branch):**

1. `src/shared/components/engagement/_v2/ActivityHeatmap/index.tsx`
   - Line 12: missing empty line between import groups
   - Line 13: `@shared/hooks/engagement/_v2/useEngagementHeatmap` should come before `./utils`

2. `src/shared/components/engagement/_v2/EngagementToolbar/index.tsx`
   - Line 12: missing empty line between import groups  
   - Line 13: `@shared/hooks/engagement/_v2/useEngagementFilterUrl` should come before `./utils`

**Root cause:** Local `./utils` import is in the same import group as `@shared/` alias imports. ESLint import/order rule requires: (1) external libs, (2) @shared/ aliases, (3) local ./ imports — each group separated by blank line.

**Fix:** In each file, move the `@shared/hooks/...` import ABOVE the `./utils` import and ensure a blank line separates the `@shared` group from the local group.

**Affects:** `npm run lint` fails — 4 new errors.
close_reason: Import/order lint errors fixed inline on verification branch (commit b90cd183). Engagement v2 lint clean.

## Context

Jest 29 + ts-jest. Run via: npm test

## Test cases (all required)

### view param
1. view defaults to 'roles' when absent from URL.
2. view parses 'permission-groups' correctly.
3. view falls back to 'roles' for unknown/invalid values.

### role toggle
4. Setting role to its current value clears it (toggle off): setValues({ role: currentRoleId }) → values.role === undefined.
5. Setting role to its current value also clears tab.
6. Setting role to a DIFFERENT value replaces it (does not clear).

### view change clears role + tab
7. Changing view to 'permission-groups' clears role and tab.

## Test structure
Use the AAA pattern (Arrange / Act / Assert):
- Arrange: set up the URL with initial params.
- Act: call setValues or simulate URL change.
- Assert: verify the resulting URL params.

Check how other hooks in the project are tested — if there is a renderHook + act + router mock pattern, follow it.

## Before creating a new file — check first
Check if the project already has a shared generic confirm dialog in @shared/components/ or a similar shared components directory. If one exists and is reusable, use it instead of creating a new file. Document your choice in the PR.

## File to ADD (if no shared dialog exists)

## Dialog content
- Title: t('AdminRolesV2.permission_groups_view.delete_confirm_title')
- Body: t('AdminRolesV2.permission_groups_view.delete_confirm_body', { name: group.name })
- Two actions: Cancel (secondary) + Delete (destructive/danger variant)

## On Delete confirm
1. Call deletePermissionGroup(id) from src/apis/private-api.ts.
2. On success:
   - Show toast: t('AdminRolesV2.permission_groups_view.delete_success')
   - Call onSuccess() (parent calls refetch())
   - Close dialog
3. On 409 error:
   - Show toast: t('AdminRolesV2.permission_groups_view.delete_error_in_use')
   - Close dialog. NO custom blocked-dialog UI in this change.
   - FOLLOW-UP BEAD (do not implement): DeletePermissionGroupBlockedDialog — show in-use roles + reassign flow on 409.
4. On other errors:
   - Show toast: t('AdminRolesV2.permission_groups_view.error_generic')
   - Close dialog.

## Wire up in PermissionGroupsView.tsx (or PermissionGroupCard.tsx)
- Replace the stub handleDelete with: open this dialog with the group id and name.
- Pass onSuccess={() => refetch()} to the dialog.

## Context

- name: required string, min length 2
- code: required string, pattern /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/ (kebab-case). Auto-derived from name until the user manually edits code. After user edits code directly, stop auto-deriving.

title: T10.1: Implement 3-part refresh contract
description:
## Why Per feedback_admin_v2_refresh_ux.md and mockup #02, three things happen simultaneously during refetch: data area dims, toolbar locks, stat strip dims. All three are required. ## Mockup reference - /Users/apple/Projects/agentflow/lf-iq/mockups/admin-roles-v2/index_02_loading_refresh.html ## File paths (create or edit) - /Users/apple/Projects/agentflow/lf-iq/src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/roles/_v2/RolesPage/RolesPage.tsx (wrappers) - /Users/apple/Projects/agentflow/lf-iq/src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/roles/_v2/_components/RolesStatStrip/RolesStatStrip.tsx (wrappers) - /Users/apple/Projects/agentflow/lf-iq/src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/roles/_v2/_components/RolesToolbar/RolesToolbar.tsx (wrappers) - /Users/apple/Projects/agentflow/lf-iq/src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/roles/_v2/_components/RolesListPane/RolesListPane.tsx (wrappers) ## Implementation notes Read isLoading and isFetching from existing useRolesQuery hook. During isFetching && !isLoading (refresh, NOT initial load): 1. List pane data area: wrap rows container with aria-busy={true} className="opacity-60 pointer-events-none transition-opacity". Render real rows underneath — do NOT render skeletons. 2. Toolbar: wrap with aria-disabled={true} className="opacity-50 pointer-events-none"; pass disabled={true} to all inputs/selects/buttons. Refresh button shows spinner. 3. Stat strip: wrap with aria-busy={true} className="opacity-60 pointer-events-none". Numbers stay visible. 4. Animated bar:
at top of list pane card (above column header row), conditionally rendered on isFetching. 5. AppBar: {t("detail.refreshing")} + small spinner — renders when isFetching. During isLoading && !data (initial): existing skeletons render normally — do not change this behavior. Use Tailwind transitions (transition-opacity) to avoid flicker. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] All five visual changes occur simultaneously when triggering Refresh. - [ ] Initial load behavior unchanged (skeletons still render). - [ ] No flicker between refresh and idle states (use Tailwind transitions). ## Project conventions (lf-iq) — MUST follow - Mantine + Tailwind: No Stack / Group / Text / Title from Mantine. Use Tailwind flex, space-y-*, native p/h1. No style={{}}. - i18n: Always useTranslations(). Never hardcode user-visible text. snake_case keys inside CamelCase namespace AdminRolesV2. - Refresh UX: On isFetching && !isLoading, dim data area (opacity-60 + aria-busy), lock toolbar (disabled + opacity-50), dim stat strip — all three required. - Null safety: Always assume fields can be null/undefined. - Branch base: Branch from production, not master. Branch name agent/-. One commit per task: feat: [<bd-id>]. ## Repo - /Users/apple/Projects/agentflow/lf-iq - Base branch: production

9. users = useEngagementUsers({ from, to, level, search, page: pagination.pageIndex, pageSize: pagination.pageSize })
10. Sync users.totalPages into pagination.totalPages via useEffect
11. handleRefresh = useCallback that calls overview.refetch() + recent.refetch() + users.refetch()

description:
## Task T2.1 — Create useEngagementFilterUrl.ts (URL-as-source hook)

**Repo:** lf-iq at /Users/apple/Projects/agentflow/lf-iq
**Base branch:** production (NOT master)
**Branch:** agent/<this-bead-id>-t2-url-hook (replace <this-bead-id> after claiming)
**Depends on:** T1.4 (all Phase 1 must be complete)

## Context

This hook is the single source of truth for ?from, ?to, ?tab URL params on /admin/engagement. ALL filter state reads from this hook. NO useState mirror of URL params anywhere in the v2 shell. This is Pattern A from the existing useUserFilterUrl.

## Reference file to read first

/Users/apple/Projects/agentflow/lf-iq/src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/users/_v2/_hooks/useUserFilterUrl.ts

Read it fully and mirror the exact pattern for engagement.

## What to Create

**Path:** /Users/apple/Projects/agentflow/lf-iq/src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/engagement/_v2/_hooks/useEngagementFilterUrl.ts

**URL params to own:**
| Param | Type | Default | Validation |
|-------|------|---------|------------|
| from | ISO 8601 datetime string | dayjs().subtract(30, 'day').startOf('day').toISOString(), clamped to '2026-04-01T00:00:00.000Z' floor | regex match for ISO datetime; invalid → default |
| to | ISO 8601 datetime string | dayjs().endOf('day').toISOString() | same |
| tab | 'overview' or 'users' or 'sections' | 'overview' | whitelist check; invalid → 'overview' |

**Date floor clamping:** if computed default for 'from' is before 2026-04-01T00:00:00.000Z, clamp to that date.
**Serialization rule:** omit params equal to defaults to keep URL canonical. Always set from/to if they differ from defaults. Always set tab if not 'overview'.

**Required exports:**

```ts
export interface EngagementFilterValues {
  from: string  // ISO datetime
  to: string    // ISO datetime
  tab: 'overview' | 'users' | 'sections'
}

export const DEFAULT_ENGAGEMENT_FILTER_VALUES: EngagementFilterValues

export const parseEngagementFilterFromSearchParams: (sp: URLSearchParams) => EngagementFilterValues

export const serializeEngagementFilterToSearchParams: (v: EngagementFilterValues) => URLSearchParams

export const useEngagementFilterUrl: () => {
  values: EngagementFilterValues
  setValues: (next: EngagementFilterValues) => void
  setTab: (next: EngagementFilterValues['tab']) => void
  setDateRange: (from: string, to: string) => void
}
```

**Implementation rules:**
- Read with useSearchParams from next/navigation. Parse + validate. Fall back to defaults on invalid input.
- Write with router.replace(url, { scroll: false }) — no history push per keystroke.
- useMemo the parsed values keyed on searchParams.toString().
- All updates produce a new object (immutable). No mutation.
- setValues replaces all params. setTab replaces only tab. setDateRange replaces only from/to.

## Constraints

- No useState mirror of the URL params — URL is the ONLY source of truth.
- No global Jotai state for these filter values.
- Must use useSearchParams + router.replace (not useState + useEffect sync pattern).
- All values immutable — never mutate the EngagementFilterValues object.
- Null guards: optional chaining on searchParams?.get() results.
- Import dayjs from the project's existing dayjs instance (check how other v2 hooks import it — likely import dayjs from 'dayjs').

## Files touched

- CREATE: src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/engagement/_v2/_hooks/useEngagementFilterUrl.ts
- DO NOT TOUCH: any other file

Manual test: change date filter -> URL updates without page navigation (router.replace, no push). Click browser back -> URL + filter values restore correctly. Invalid URL param falls back to default silently.

title: Fix Round 1.2 - Add Label.showing_x_y_of_n_fields i18n key and use in modal pagination
description:
## Context
Fix loop Round 1 — TESTER reported hardcoded English string 'Showing X–Y of N fields' at lines 167–169 of AuditLogDetailModalV2/index.tsx. All copy must use useTranslations(). Original work was task 2.1 (modal shell) plus i18n keys in task 5.1.

## Files

- lf-iq/src/messages/ko.json
- lf-iq/src/messages/vi.json
- lf-iq/src/messages/zh.json
- lf-iq/src/messages/he.json
- lf-iq/src/messages/es.json
- lf-iq/src/messages/ar.json

## Implementation

### Step 1 — Add new i18n key to all 7 locale files
Add under Label namespace, ICU format with {start}, {end}, {total}. Place near existing Label.page_x_of_y for visual consistency.

| Locale | Translation |
|--------|-------------|
| en | Showing {start}–{end} of {total} fields |
| ko | {total}개 필드 중 {start}–{end}개 표시 중 |
| vi | Hiển thị {start}–{end} trên {total} trường |
| zh | 显示 {start}–{end}，共 {total} 个字段 |
| he | מציג {start}–{end} מתוך {total} שדות |
| es | Mostrando {start}–{end} de {total} campos |
| ar | عرض {start}–{end} من {total} حقل |

Use en-dash – (U+2013), NOT a hyphen -, matching existing Label.page_x_of_y convention.

### Step 2 — Replace hardcoded JSX in index.tsx (lines 167–169)
Find the existing JSX which contains a string like:
  Showing {pageInfo.currentPage * pageSize + 1}–{...} of {pageInfo.totalElements} fields

Replace with:
  {t('Label.showing_x_y_of_n_fields', {
    start: pageIndex * pageSize + 1,
    end: Math.min((pageIndex + 1) * pageSize, pageInfo.totalElements),
    total: pageInfo.totalElements
  })}

Where start and end are the existing computed values from the JSX expression. Confirm t is the useTranslations() instance already used elsewhere in the same component.

Do NOT remove or rename Label.page_x_of_y — that key remains in use for the right-side page indicator.

Branch from feature/audit-tab-v2-redesign. Branch name: agent/<bead-id>-fix-1-2-pagination-i18n.

- No hardcoded English string 'Showing' (followed by en-dash pattern) remains in AuditLogDetailModalV2/index.tsx — verify with: grep -n "Showing" lf-iq/src/shared/components/AuditLogDetailModalV2/index.tsx returning no matches
- The pagination footer renders the localized string when the app locale is switched to vi, zh, ko, etc. (manual spot check on at least 2 non-English locales)

## Phase 2.3 — useCronJobActions Hook

## File to Create
lf-iq/src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/cron-jobs/_v2/_hooks/useCronJobActions.ts

## Imports Needed
- startCronJob, pauseCronJob, resumeCronJob, stopCronJob from '@apis/private-api'
- useQueryClient from '@tanstack/react-query'
- useToast from '@hooks/useToast' (check exact export — may be named hook or default)
- useTranslations from 'next-intl'
- extractErrorMessage from '@utils/errorUtils' (check exact export name)
- useState from 'react'

## Implementation

Internal state: actionLoading: string | null (tracks which job ID is mid-action)

Single internal run function:
  async function run(action: 'start' | 'pause' | 'resume' | 'stop', jobId: string): Promise<void>
    1. Set actionLoading to jobId
    2. Call appropriate API: startCronJob(jobId), pauseCronJob(jobId), resumeCronJob(jobId), stopCronJob(jobId)
    3. On success (no error in response):
       - Call notifySuccess (from useToast) with message: t('Notification.action_successfully', { type: t('Noun.cron_job'), action: t('Action.' + action) })
       - Invalidate queryClient key ['admin', 'cron-jobs', 'list'] to trigger refetch
    4. On error:
       - Call notifyError (from useToast) with extractErrorMessage(err)
    5. Finally: set actionLoading to null

Return object:
  { start: (id: string) => Promise<void>, pause: (id: string) => Promise<void>, resume: (id: string) => Promise<void>, stop: (id: string) => Promise<void>, actionLoading: string | null }

Each returned function is a closure: (id) => run(action, id)

## TypeScript Constraints
- No 'any' types
- Action type is a union literal: 'start' | 'pause' | 'resume' | 'stop'
- useToast return type — check the hook file at lf-iq/src/hooks/ to get the exact notifySuccess/notifyError API

## Acceptance Criteria
- File exists at lf-iq/src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/cron-jobs/_v2/_hooks/useCronJobActions.ts
- Named export 'useCronJobActions'
- Invalidates ['admin', 'cron-jobs', 'list'] on success (must match exactly the queryKey in useCronJobsQuery)
- actionLoading is null when idle, set to the job ID while running
- npx tsc --noEmit exits 0
- Lint clean

lf-iq/src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/cron-jobs/_v2/_hooks/useCronJobStatistics.ts

## Implementation
Export a named pure function (NOT a hook): computeCronJobStats(jobs: CronJob[])

Return type: { total: number; active: number; paused: number; stopped: number; failedLastRun: number }

Computation:
- total = jobs.length
- active = jobs.filter(j => ['RUNNING', 'RESUMED', 'SCHEDULED'].includes(j.job_status)).length
- paused = jobs.filter(j => j.job_status === 'PAUSED').length
- stopped = jobs.filter(j => j.job_status === 'STOPPED').length
- failedLastRun = jobs.filter(j => j.last_complete_status === 'FAILED').length

Import CronJob from '@shared/types/cron-job-types'

This is a pure function — no hooks, no useQuery, no state. Consumers wrap the call in useMemo.

## TypeScript Constraints
- No 'any' types
- jobs parameter typed as CronJob[]
- Return type explicitly declared (not inferred)

## Task
Create lf-iq/src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/plans/_v2/_hooks/useViewMode.ts

Implementation:
1. Define Jotai atom typed 'grid' | 'table' persisted to localStorage key 'plans-v2-view-mode' via atomWithStorage
2. Wrap localStorage access in try/catch for private-mode safety (fall back to in-memory atom value)
3. SSR-safe: initial render returns 'grid' default; reconcile in useEffect after mount to avoid hydration mismatch
4. On mount, read URL ?view= param: if 'grid' or 'table', write through to atom (overrides localStorage); invalid values are ignored
5. setViewMode updates both atom (auto-persists to localStorage) and URL ?view= param
6. Return: [viewMode, setViewMode]

URL precedence on first load: URL ?view= > localStorage > default 'grid'

Segmented view-mode toggle UX (document in JSDoc or component notes):
- Two segments: 'grid' (Tabler IconLayoutGrid) and 'table' (Tabler IconList)
- role='radiogroup' with role='radio' per option, aria-checked

- Active visual: bg-white shadow-[inset_0_0_0_1px_#E5E7EB]
- Inactive visual: text-[#6B7280] hover:text-[#111827]

## Jest unit tests (REQUIRED - create in same PR)
Cover:
- Default value is 'grid' when nothing set
- URL ?view=table on first load yields viewMode === 'table'
- localStorage value persists across simulated reload when no ?view= is present
- Invalid ?view=xyz value is ignored (falls back to grid or localStorage)

## Acceptance criteria

title: Build useConversationFiltersUrl hook (URL search params state)
description:
REPO: lf-iq (/Users/apple/Projects/agentflow/lf-iq/)
BRANCH: feature/conversation-history-v2 (base: production)

FILE TO CREATE:
/Users/apple/Projects/agentflow/lf-iq/src/app/[locale]/(admin)/admin/conversation-history/_v2/_hooks/useConversationFiltersUrl.ts

BLOCKED ON: Epic 2 (Task 2.2) must be complete first.
DEPENDS ON: Task 4.1 (buildConversationFilter helper exported from useConversationHistoryV2.ts).

GOAL: Reflect filters and pagination in the URL query string for shareability and back-button support.

CONTRACT:
  export interface ConversationFiltersUrlState {
    search: string
    channel: 'ALL' | 'DEVICE' | 'EMAIL' | 'SMS'
    type: 'ALL' | string
    status: 'ALL' | string
    page: number     // 0-indexed
    pageSize: number // default 20
  }

  export function useConversationFiltersUrl(): {
    filters: ConversationFiltersUrlState
    setFilters: (patch: Partial<ConversationFiltersUrlState>) => void
    resetFilters: () => void
    filterExpression: string  // from buildConversationFilter
  }

IMPLEMENTATION RULES:
1. Use useSearchParams(), useRouter(), usePathname() from 'next/navigation'.
2. filters derived from searchParams.get(...) with defaults:
   search='', channel='ALL', type='ALL', status='ALL', page=0, pageSize=20
3. setFilters(patch) builds new URLSearchParams from current + patch, then:
   router.replace(pathname + '?' + params.toString(), { scroll: false })
   Use replace (NOT push) to avoid flooding browser history on search keystrokes.
4. When patch changes any of search/channel/type/status AND page is NOT in the patch → also set page back to 0.
5. When a field equals its default, REMOVE it from the URL (cleaner URLs):
   - search='': remove 'search' param
   - channel='ALL': remove 'channel' param
   - type='ALL': remove 'type' param
   - status='ALL': remove 'status' param
   - page=0: remove 'page' param
   - pageSize=20: remove 'pageSize' param
6. resetFilters() calls router.replace(pathname, { scroll: false }) to clear all params.
7. filterExpression = useMemo(() => buildConversationFilter(channel, type, status), [channel, type, status])
   Import buildConversationFilter from './useConversationHistoryV2'

ANTI-PATTERN TO AVOID (from design.md):
- URL param state loops with debounced search: use router.replace + scroll: false + a ref-tracked 'last applied' value to prevent re-triggering on its own change. Pattern mirrored from ReportsToolbar keyword debounce.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- Typing in the toolbar search field (via setFilters) updates the URL to ?search=foo
- Clicking a stat card (via setFilters({ status: 'SENT' })) sets ?status=SENT in the URL
- Reloading the page restores all filters from URL
- Calling resetFilters() clears all params and navigates to the bare pathname
- Changing filters while on page 3 resets to page 0 (URL no longer contains 'page')
- URL fields at their default are omitted from the URL string
close_reason: URL filter hook created in branch agent/agentflow-9c0.3-url-filters, tsc passes, build passes
